analyzed_vuln.description: In ReadPSInfo(), the code obtains a pointer from GetMagickByteBufferDatum(&buffer) and passes it to SetImageProperty() as a C string (e.g. p=...+4 for "!PS-" at line ~329). That buffer datum is not guaranteed to be NUL-terminated for the current parsed line/chunk, but SetImageProperty() duplicates it via ConstantString(value), which calls strlen(). This causes an out-of-bounds read from the stack buffer when no terminator exists before the end of the local buffer.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger with PS/EPS input parsed by ping/read path so ReadPSInfo() processes DSC-like tokens (notably the PostscriptLevel "!PS-" branch). Provide data where the MagickByteBuffer line content referenced by GetMagickByteBufferDatum() lacks an in-bounds NUL terminator (or is attacker-controlled to defer NUL), then SetImageProperty(image,"ps:Level",p,...) invokes ConstantString/strlen on that unterminated pointer, producing stack-buffer-overflow read.
